reproduce.title: Reproduce spreadsheet cells becoming pictures
prerequisites: Two PCs connected through Mouse Without Borders.
Excel or WPS Spreadsheet installed on both PCs.
steps: Open workbooks on both PCs and copy a cell range from PC 1 to PC 2.
Paste on PC 2, then copy and paste cells within the same sheet, another sheet, and another workbook.
Repeat in the opposite direction and record whether any paste inserts an image instead of editable cells.
During reproduction, inspect the available clipboard formats before and after the cross-PC transfer.
reproduce.expected_result: Spreadsheet cell ranges paste as editable cells across PCs and continue to paste as editable cells locally.

confidence.rationale: The sequence and environments are specific, but the responsible clipboard-format transition is not yet confirmed.

judgment.rationale: The issue gives concrete Windows versions, Office applications, two-PC setup, numbered steps, and a public diagnostic attachment. That is enough for maintainer-side reproduction, but not enough to claim a root cause.
evidence: PowerToys 0.100.2 on Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11 25H2 with Mouse Without Borders.
Copying spreadsheet cells between the connected PCs is followed by cells pasting as pictures, including later same-PC paste operations.
The issue includes a public MouseWithoutBorders.zip diagnostic attachment.
No comments, assignee, closing PR, or other concrete linked fix is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with Excel or WPS on two connected PCs and inspect the clipboard formats before and after the cross-PC transfer.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys clipboard-transfer change may be applicable, but the failing format-selection boundary must be confirmed before implementation.

issue_context.summary: After copying spreadsheet cells between two Mouse Without Borders-connected PCs, later pastes can insert pictures instead of editable cells, even within the same workbook.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve spreadsheet cell clipboard formats across Mouse Without Borders transfer
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Mouse Without Borders may restore or prioritize a rendered image clipboard format after a cross-PC spreadsheet transfer instead of preserving the native spreadsheet formats; this is an unconfirmed hypothesis.
plan: Reproduce the two-PC Excel/WPS sequence and enumerate clipboard formats before transfer, after remote paste, and during the later local paste.
Trace the Mouse Without Borders clipboard serialization and restoration path only after the format change is observed.
Adjust format ordering or restoration lifetime at the confirmed boundary and add a focused regression check for native spreadsheet cell paste.
verification: Repeat the reported cross-PC and subsequent same-PC paste sequence in Excel and WPS and verify cells remain editable cells rather than images.
Verify ordinary text, image, and file clipboard transfers still behave correctly.

confidence.rationale: The symptom strongly implicates clipboard format selection after MWB transfer, but reproduction is needed to identify the exact boundary.
